```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD CMS CONTENT
# ----------------------------------------------------------

with open("../../content/whalewatch.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

hero = data.get("hero", {})
cards = data.get("cards", [])

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PROJECT CARDS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

card_html = ""

for card in cards:

    card_html += f"""
    <article class="cw-whale-card">

      <div class="cw-whale-card-content">

        <h3>{safe(card.get('title'))}</h3>

        <p>{safe(card.get('description'))}</p>

      </div>

      <a class="cw-whale-card-btn"
         href="{safe(card.get('button_url'))}">
        {safe(card.get('button_label'))}
        <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
      </a>

    </article>
    """

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PAGE HTML
# ----------------------------------------------------------

html = f"""
<div class="cw-whale">

  <!-- PROJECT NAVIGATION -->
  <div class="cw-whale-topbar">

    <nav class="cw-whale-tabs"
         aria-label="WhaleWatch navigation">

      <a class="cw-whale-tab is-active"
         href="whalewatch.html"
         aria-current="page">
        WhaleWatch 2.0
      </a>

      <a class="cw-whale-tab"
         href="about-whalewatch.html">
        About WhaleWatch 2.0
      </a>

      <a class="cw-whale-tab"
         href="whalewatch-products.html">
        WhaleWatch 2.0 Products
      </a>

      <a class="cw-whale-tab"
         href="whalewatch-explorer.html">
        WhaleWatch 2.0 Explorer
      </a>

    </nav>

  </div>

  <!-- HERO IMAGE -->
  <section class="cw-whale-image-hero">

    <img src="{safe(hero.get('image'))}"
         alt="{safe(hero.get('image_alt'))}">

    <div class="cw-whale-image-overlay">

      <span class="cw-whale-eyebrow">
        {safe(hero.get('eyebrow'))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(hero.get('title'))}</h1>

      <p>{safe(hero.get('subtitle'))}</p>

    </div>

  </section>

  <div class="cw-whale-image-caption">
    {safe(hero.get('image_caption'))}
  </div>

  <!-- INTRODUCTION -->
  <section class="cw-whale-intro">

    <div class="cw-whale-intro-accent"></div>

    <p>{safe(hero.get('description'))}</p>

  </section>

  <!-- PROJECT CARDS -->
  <section class="cw-whale-card-grid">

    {card_html}

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
